name: Leaders in Training (LIT)
org: City of San Ramon Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Learn leadership and job skills in class. Then volunteer for a week at a time at city summer camps. You work with kids and learn from staff.
who_can_apply: The page says this is a teen program. It does not give an age or grade range. You must go to at least 4 of the 5 classes. You must also be free to volunteer for at least one weeklong shift in the summer.
pay_detail: Volunteer role. The page does not say if the classes cost money. Shifts are mornings (7:30 AM to 1:00 PM) or afternoons (12:30 to 4:15 PM).
duration: 5 classes, then weeklong volunteer shifts (Monday to Friday)
deadline_text: The 2026 program is full and closed. The page says to check back in March for next year.
how_to_apply: The 2026 program is closed. Check the program page in March for next year. The city also offers a fall class called Teen Service and Leadership.
notes: You can volunteer for as few as one assignment or as many as you like. The page does not say if the program has a fee. Ask the city before you sign up.
